referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for an office building with offices, common rooms, kitchen, restaurant, auditorium and car park. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 10161 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 54400 m3/h, total weight of the components: 15755 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 5.4 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: c4e07610-8363-3ecf-b332-006b66f3ae79
